title: Roadmap and scope documentation
description:
## Goal
Make the roadmap and scope text match reality.

## State when stopped
Branch `claude/project-thread-dmru5y-roadmap-scope` is pushed with one commit that edits `README.md` and `docs/roadmap.md`. The Sphinx build was not run, and `AGENTS.md` has no scope section yet.

## Work
1. Merge current `origin/main`. Review the commit; keep the voice plain, no em-dashes, project vocabulary only.
2. `docs/roadmap.md`: Tactus integration is a completed foundation (Tactus depends on `biblicus>=1.11.3` and uses the context engine, workflow planner, `Corpus`, and text utilities). Replace "Next" with: curation surface on main; consumer contract for Papyrus (`biblicus.api`, `Corpus` path methods, `metadata.papyrus`); learned decisions move to Cyclotron.
3. Add a "Scope boundary" section to `AGENTS.md` and a short "What Biblicus does not do" paragraph to `README.md`: no editorial state (Papyrus), no learning from human labels (Cyclotron), no publishing (Papyrus and Markus).
4. `poetry run sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html` succeeds without new warnings.

## Done when
PR to `main` is green and merged.
